newsitem.title: ESTONIA: THOMSON TO DO MORE LATVIA, ESTONIA BANK RATINGS.
newsitem.headline: THOMSON TO DO MORE LATVIA, ESTONIA BANK RATINGS.

text.p: Rating agency Thomson Bankwatch said on Thursday that it expected soon to issue a rating for Estonian bank Tallinna Pank and other top Estonian banks and would also do one for leading Latvian bank, Parex.
Thomson yesterday issued a sovereign rating for Estonia and one for leading Estonian bank, Hansapank .
"We have a rating on Tallinna Pank coming out, other ones are further behind," Ramin Habibi, president of Thomson Bankwatch-BRE told Reuters in an interview.
"The intention that we have is to cover all the significant banks in the Baltics," he added.
"Parex is coming out shortly," Habibi added.
He said that a rating for Unibanka would also be done.
"We woudl aim within the next three months to release more reports on Latvian banks," he said.

He noted that Thomson has already done a rating on Rigas kommercbanka, the third-largest Latvian bank, when it was given a BB- long-term local and foreign debt rating and a short-term local currency rating of two out of four.
